title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Safety Signs
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which color is generally used to indicate 'Danger' or 'Stop' on safety signs?
questions.explain: Red is the universal color used for prohibitory signs, fire equipment, and danger signals (e.g., Stop signs).
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Pedestrian crossings are usually marked on the road with:
questions.explain: Zebra crossings are marked with alternating black and white stripes on the road surface.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
